detail.longDescription: I'm creating my own OS system. Check it out. A lot has been written in C. So, I created my own OS called LimonOS. It's in early development. What's unique is that it's not Linux or Unix—the kernel is unique and 98% written in C. Yes, I used the AI assistant because I had a headache and there were a lot of errors and problems, since I was the only one doing and thinking about it. Development has been going on for four days now. Here's a link to the OS itself—we recently added a browser and internet connection: https://github.com/AnonimusShamshiAlex/LimonOS OSsystem Limon Full AI+Braves TLS.rar here. LimonOS9_3.zip here . The code itself and the entire OS system are there. There's a problem: if you're using Windows, we need to click the batch file, and everything will compile using WSL Linux and Limine for implementation. Everything is on GitHub, all the instructions, and you'll probably find it easy to try it out on a virtual machine. I'm writing this because I want your opinion and suggestions on how to improve this OS so it works and becomes stable, like other OSes, like Linux. I'm having a blast creating my own OS, like Terry Davis, and I hope I don't go crazy. Here are the interface screenshots . I recently added them to the AI terminal. You can connect with the aikey command <your openrouter.ai API key here>. Then you can use the ai command. ai hi my name is Jucy. Here are the interface screenshots. Thanks everyone Thanky you
